crossRefs.note: The people said to Saul, “Shall Jonathan die, who has worked this great salvation in Israel? Far from it! As Yahweh…
Then she said, “Please let the king remember Yahweh your God, that the avenger of blood destroy not any more, lest they…
Solomon said, “If he shows himself a worthy man, not a hair of his shall fall to the earth; but if wickedness is found…
But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
And not a hair of your head will perish.
Therefore I beg you to take some food; for this is for your safety; for not a hair will perish from any of your heads.”
